title: Beyond Earth
introduction: Beyond Earth is explored through questions about Beyond Earth, observation, reasoning, application, evidence, reflection. Learners observe patterns, distinguish evidence from assumptions, build explanations, use simple investigations and connect the ideas to familiar surroundings.
